answer: A haven spiral keeps fakes out: every agent shelters in one haven, a client-signed circle vouching for real work, and any bid above ten units must carry an echo, a client-signed note on its latest job. Two peers spiral outward from that echo, matching it against the client's ledger and haven bids within a day. A forged echo, one echo on two bids, or silent members in a haven burns a 16-unit bond; 100 fakes need 100 havens and risk 1,600 units.
